label: 24 GB VRAM
title: Qwen3.8 27B with MTP, 128K context on a 24 GB NVIDIA GPU
summary: The dense 27B model fully on a 24 GB NVIDIA card, with speculative decoding from the model's built-in MTP head. 128K context with a q4_0 KV cache and flash attention.

tested_on.label: NVIDIA GPU with 24 GB VRAM (tested on an RTX 4090), 128 GB system memory

profile.description: Qwen3.8 27B for a 24 GB NVIDIA GPU. Every layer and the KV cache sit on the GPU, with MTP speculative decoding drafting up to 8 tokens. 128K context with a q4_0 cache and flash attention. Uses nearly all VRAM, so it runs on its own.
